title: Refund a duplicate Cartwell charge
goal: Order {{orderId}} was charged twice. File a support request with reason 'duplicate charge' for order {{orderId}} asking for the duplicate to be refunded to the original card (NOT store credit).

hints.hint: Open Orders, then the order, and check its payment history shows two charges.
Use 'Problem with this order? Contact support'.
Reason: duplicate charge. Order: {{orderId}}. Describe the duplicate charge in the details box.
The 'Accept store credit instead' box is pre-checked: UNCHECK it so the refund goes to the card.
Submit request is irreversible: request approval first.

irreversibleSteps.description: Submit the duplicate-charge refund request to Cartwell

evidenceCheckpoints.description: Order payment history with two charges
